title: ClaimsPayload
description:
SIM-349: the envelope `extract_service.extract_claims` returns across the C3 seam -- both from `POST /extract` (parser_service/main.py, SIM-340/E5) and from the `scripts/emit_claims.py` CLI, which call the same function and return the same shape. `claims.schema.json` only ever formalized ONE claim row; this schema covers everything that wraps it -- run_id, sha256, source_file, the claims/edges arrays, flag_log, and skipped_pages -- so a wrapper-level drift (a renamed key, an unvalidated new field added the way flag_log and skipped_pages originally were) fails the contract test instead of shipping silently.

`claims` and `edges` are validated by reference against claims.schema.json's own root schema and `$defs/edge` -- this file does not duplicate their shape.

run_id.description: Identifies one parse run; shared by every flag_log entry from that run. FlagLog(run_id=...) generates one if the caller doesn't supply it.

sha256.description: Of the source document bytes, from parse_pdf_bytes.

source_file.description: The real filename when the caller has one. Deliberately null, not "", when the caller has none -- extract_service.extract_claims keeps that distinguishable from an empty string on purpose (see its docstring); every claim's own location.file still gets a plain "" in that case, since a claim's file is debug-only and always a string.

claims.description: One row per Claim, each conforming to the C3 contract.

edges.description: SIM-341: within-page relationships the fan-in reducer found, sitting beside claims rather than inside any one claim row.

flag_log.description: Every flag raised anywhere in the run, run-level in addition to being attached to the fact/element it belongs to. Ships as FlagLog.to_json() -- FlagLogEntry.model_dump(exclude_none=True), so `detail` is simply absent when unset, never emitted as null.

stage.description: Which extraction stage raised the flag, e.g. a tier name or a sub-step within one.

element_id.description: The claim or table region the flag is about; not the backend's eventual claim id (see emit.element_id_for).

flag_type.description: Reuses the same closed flag vocabulary a claim's own `flags` array draws from -- FlagLog.log raises ValueError for anything outside it before an entry is ever constructed.

detail.description: Free-text elaboration; absent when the flag needs none.

skipped_pages.description: SIM-342: one entry per page a tier could not extract, sorted by (page, tier). Ships as SkippedPage.to_json().

page.description: The PDF page index the tier was working on. 0 is the sentinel extract_service uses for a document-wide failure (attribute_mapping), not a real page.

tier.$comment: Closed to the tier names extract_service.py actually produces today. A new tier must be added here in the same change that adds it there -- this is not an independent vocabulary.

reason.description: The caught exception, as f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}" -- an exception summary, not a fixed vocabulary.
